failure_pattern_summary: Current router validates settlement payloads through _validate_subcontract_settlement_gate before business branches. Existing target test payloads only include legacy fields such as inspection_ids, statement_id, statement_no, idempotency_key, remark, or reason, while current gate requires carrier fields including request_id, operation, scenario_tag, source_ref, subcontract_ref, supplier_ref, work_order_ref, item_code, quantity, and status_action. This produces early 422 responses and blocks original 200/409/500 business assertions.
